citations.claim: first energy_bound violation: total energy well above initial at step 61 right after floor bounce
rebound velocity exceeds incident speed despite e<1, showing energy injection
pre-impact falling speed just before bounce
pre-impact energy conserved near initial energy

counterfactual.change: changed restitution e from 0.90698 to 0.0 only; inelastic bounce removes energy gain so no energy_bound violation in same 61 steps

explanation: Single heavy circle falls under gravity and bounces on floor y=0 between steps 60-61. Incident vy=-18.67 becomes rebound vy=+19.73, i.e. speed increases despite e=0.907 (expected ~16.9). With no controller work, total energy jumps from ~3017 J to ~3363 J, exceeding E0+10%+5J. Likely cause: floor impulse/positional-correction adds energy at high impact speed (substeps=7), effectively restitution>1, possibly gravity applied inside substep collision loop or over-correction.
vision_note: A single small blue circle falls vertically toward the bottom boundary across steps 58 to 60 and contacts the floor at step 61. No tunneling, wall overlap, or visible high rebound is shown; the motion is consistent with a floor impact at the reported violating step.
